analysis.primary_estimand: PDB-equal-weighted mean of per-entry AP after averaging the three fixed seed-specific AP values within entry
analysis.zero_positive_rule: exclude from the corresponding per-entry AP denominator and report the excluded count; retain all observed labels for pooled metrics
analysis.zero_negative_rule: exclude from AUROC only and report the excluded count

required_conditions: all six no-distance development runs verified

contact_label_definition.antibody_axis: metadata H_sequence followed by L_sequence when present
contact_label_definition.antigen_axis: metadata antigen chains in declared antigen_chain_id order
contact_label_definition.contact: minimum cross-partner non-hydrogen atom distance at most 4.5 angstrom
contact_label_definition.coordinate_source: SABLE v0.2.0 experimental bound structure, used for labels only
contact_label_definition.missing_residues: unobserved or unmappable residues are masked from evaluation, never assigned negative labels
contact_label_definition.paratope: antibody residue has at least one observed positive contact
contact_label_definition.epitope: antigen residue has at least one observed positive contact
contact_label_definition.sequence_mapping: deterministic chain-specific order-preserving mapping of observed coordinate residues onto the metadata sequence; non-identical mapped amino acids fail closed

external_data.split: official v0.2.0 test split followed by the frozen FrameContact label-free double-cold screen

geometry_input.source: independent sequence-predicted chain-internal AlphaFold 3 N/CA/C backbone geometry

model_binding_rule.contact: no-distance baseline checkpoint from the same seed
model_binding_rule.epitope: no-distance TopK2 expert checkpoint from the same seed
model_binding_rule.paratope: no-distance baseline checkpoint from the same seed

sequence: complete and SHA-bind all label-free AF3 predictions
complete and SHA-bind the no-distance checkpoints
download and SHA-verify the SABLE bound structures
